id: title:JakeRuth:label min priority picker with the range it covers

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies user-facing description for Slack notification settings, potentially reducing support requests or configuration errors.
review.reason: The chunk consists entirely of documentation and label changes. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F6.H1 update option labels and comments to clarify priority ranges and help text. No implementation, tests, or backend behavior changes are supplied. The tier is assigned as 1 because the change is narrow, localized, and limited to documentation, despite the unverified benefit.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on unverified outcomes; no implementation or tests are supplied.
